correctness.rationale: The path/cycle count follows from the precise DP-Nash definitions, degree-two star decomposition into 2- and 3-vertex tiles, integer constraints l=2n-3k and j=2k-n, and rooted-cycle double counting giving n/(n-k). The bivariate rooted-cycle log formula and roots of λ³−2zλ−z²=0 yield a unique analytic dominant root near z=1; two exact logarithmic derivatives give μ=1−1/√5 and σ²=1−11/(5√5)>0; characteristic functions establish the CLT. The packaged standard-library program independently verifies 77 finite identities/checks, without using finite data as proof.

value.rationale: Exact quota-refined counts classify the feasible contributor numbers and numbers of complete specialized equilibria on path and cyclic sharing networks. Closing a path gives a precise quota-dependent multiplicative change and the CLT identifies typical contributor density and finite-size variability. The main objective answers a natural counting question raised in the exact-capacitated-domination literature; it is more substantive than the known scalar Lucas recurrence and retains explicit scope limits.
